match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. close-up. slightly above. Mina’s open palm and coral lipstick sit in the sunlit foreground while Scarlett and the glowing skyline fall softly behind. Mina holds the coral lipstick open in her palm while facing Scarlett, both women smiling beside the rooftop wall. Then: Mina closes her fingers around the lipstick, takes Scarlett’s hand, and pulls her toward the stairwell. Camera: pull-out, smooth. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height, Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried. Mina, Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s, Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
